notes: Pridemalkin (ETB: +1/+1 counter on target creature you control) ENTERS (creature cast is the systematic not_a_spell gap) and its ETB trigger asks - the designation answer 'c' lands the counter on Sigiled Contender. The conditional static then flips: 3/3 -> 4/4 and lifelink appears on the layers lane ('has lifelink as long as it has a +1/+1 counter'). Pridemalkin's own static ('each creature you control with a +1/+1 counter has trample') stacks on the same counter, so the layers lane reads LIFELINK+TRAMPLE.
